# ORIGIN — Genesis record of Time Resolution Theory (TRT)

**Status of this file:** Archival record of the original vision as first proposed.  
**Not** a list of validated results. Do not edit this folder to “match” later conclusions.

**Primary source:** `TRT_v2.4_original.pdf` (Version 2.4, Joshua B. Girod, CC BY 4.0).

---

## The one line to preserve

> If the universe has no master clock, it is just noise.

(Epigraph, Version 2.4.)

Closing form in the same work:

> Time never dilates. Resolution does.

---

## Seed

The work began from a network-engineering picture of communication: two modems exchanging structured data **without a shared timing reference** produce only noise. The original claim is that the same structure applies to the universe: a single **Uniform Time** (master clock), anchored to the cosmic mass-energy scale, is required for any repeatable pattern—interference, atoms, chemistry, life. Apparent quantum randomness is residual “static” seen by finite-resolution detectors decoding a deterministic signal locked to that clock.

---

## Founding metaphors (original)

These appear in Version 2.4 as the intuitive core; they are not laboratory results.

1. **Slow shutter / camera** — Coarse temporal resolution blurs fast motion into streaks or disks; a fast shutter resolves the trajectory.
2. **Hummingbird at 30 fps** — Wings appear as a blur; the blur is an artifact of under-sampling, not of the bird.
3. **Aliasing** — Sampling below the Nyquist rate of a high-frequency signal produces false low-frequency structure.
4. **Strobe wheel** — A spinning wheel under strobe light can look stationary or reversed; timing mismatch creates the illusion.
5. **PRNG** — A pseudorandom generator looks random until the seed and algorithm are known; “randomness” can be unresolved determinism.
6. **Modem with no shared clock** — Perfect information without a common timing reference is received as noise.

---

## Original scope (Version 2.4)

As written in the founding paper, TRT proposed a **deterministic, local, resolution-based framework for quantum mechanics and gravity**, including:

- Mass as unresolved energy (core formula involving resolution efficiency γ and unresolved scale Δt).
- Frequency-layered models of observation and interference under finite Δt.
- Reinterpretation of superposition and the double-slit via under-sampling / slow shutter.
- A resolution-dependence reading of Bell correlations (including adjustable-timing proposals).
- Links from temporal resolution to relativistic time dilation (resolution dilation) and gravitational gradients.
- Experimental proposals: tunable-resolution double-slit, Bell tests with adjustable timing, mass modulation.

That full scope is the **original vision**. It is recorded here so it is not erased by later narrowing of the research program.

---

## Core vs scaffolding (as the founding text presented it)

**Core (original):**

- Finite temporal resolution is physically real and observer/apparatus-dependent.
- Apparent randomness can be unresolved pattern (PRNG analogy).
- Connection / common origin (Big Bang) makes shared structure the default.
- A universal timing reference (Uniform Time / master clock) is required for coherent physics; without it, only noise.

**Scaffolding (original extensions in the same document):**

- Explicit mass–energy–resolution formulae and γ interpretation.
- Detailed Bell simulation forms and experimental tables.
- Cosmology / hierarchy tables (resolution ratio R across mass scales).
- Standard Model and gravity reinterpretations as resolution mismatch.
- “Theory of everything: time itself” framing.

Later repository work (Resolution Time Theory / RTT Core Editions) **narrowed** the live program to single-particle equilibrium statistics, detector gates, and tested mechanical routes. That narrowing is a **later research decision**. It does not rewrite what Version 2.4 claimed.
